text:
elaine: Heads-up: finance is rolling out a revision to the free credit allocation and soft quota model. Effective 2026-05-01. Main goals: reduce abuse, keep sustainable free tier economics, and give clearer upgrade signals. TL;DR below.

maria: Can you paste the exact numbers/limits? Product needs to update the signup flow copy.

elaine: Sure — new defaults: `free_credits_monthly` = 50,000 tokens, `soft_quota_buffer` = 10% of monthly allowance, burst window reduced from 48h -> 24h for free-tier accounts. Grandfathering: existing accounts created before 2026-04-01 keep current credits for 6 months.

kevin: How will this affect rate-limit headers and 429 behavior? Any planned client-breaking changes?

elaine: No breaking changes to headers. We'll surface a new header `x-free-tier-remaining` and set `Retry-After` behavior unchanged. For sustained overage we will send invoice + 48h notice before hard throttle for non-paying accounts.

sophie: Does this change the startup credits promo we hand out?

elaine: Promo remains, but we will convert part of the promotional credit into a time-limited trial bucket (30 days) rather than ongoing free monthly credits. More detail in the rollout doc.

kevin: Engineering: we need a small telemetry flag to mark accounts in the grandfather cohort and a way to emit `billing_tier_change` events. Can we get a spec?

maria: Product will own messaging and UX. We need copy variations for: new signups, grandfathered users, and trial-to-paid CTAs. I'll pair with solutions to update templates.

elaine: Plan: 
- 2026-04-01: Announcement to customers (this internal thread is preview)
- 2026-05-01: Enforcement date
- 2026-11-01: End of grandfathered extended credits

billing-bot: Invoice preview generation scheduled for 2026-05-02T03:00Z for impacted accounts.

kevin: Ops/infra note: we'll need a migration to recompute per-account `monthly_quota` and to backfill `free_tier_expiry` tags. I'll open an eng task.

elaine: We'll publish the public FAQ and a support playbook. Support will automatically be given a debug panel with: active credits, free_tier_expiry, and recent 429s.

maria: Suggest adding a one-click upgrade CTA in the Console that pre-fills expected price for next tier — reduces support friction.

elaine: Agreed. Also: rate-limit smoothing for paid customers will be unchanged; only free-tier burst window tightened.

kevin: Any expected revenue impact we should model? Finance estimated ~3–5% increase in paid conversion but a short-term dip in free usage.

elaine: Right. We modeled multiple scenarios in the deck (summary in the rollout doc). Primary reason to avoid continued unbounded free consumption patterns.

sophie: For external comms, can marketing craft a short FAQ item focusing on fairness/security and not "cost cutting"?

elaine: Yes, marketing + product to draft messaging. I'll own the customer email and priority support list for the first 2 weeks post-enforcement.

maria: Anything else? If not, I'll update the signup flow spec and tag the copy PR for review.

elaine: Thanks — we'll post the public help center article + pricing changes on 2026-04-01 and schedule a reviewer sync next Wed. :thumbsup:
